senses.gloss: m.(b. h. Kethib; נצר)guarded; (homiletically interpreted = יצר) that which is being formed, embryo, premature birth.—Pl. נְצִירִים, constr. נְצִירֵי.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:8:5">Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ</cite> <he>אפילו נפלים וכ׳</he> even premature births will have a share in the resurrection, as we read (<cite ref="Isaiah 49:6">Is. XLIX, 6</cite>) &c.
